On Sunday, Cleveland Indian's season ticket holder Greg Van Niel caught an amazing four foul balls in a single
baseball game. To put his feat in perspective, the odds of catching a single foul ball in a game is one in a
thousand. The odds of catching four foul balls in a single game is estimated to be one in a trillion. Further
adding to the improbability of Van Niel's good fortune was the fact that he wasn't even sitting in his usual seats.
